capture.policy: One-time entering design capture; literal independent inputs thereafter. Assumed estimates, not vendor quotations. Current one-module scope.

turbine.provenance: assumed entering model estimate, not vendor quotation
turbine.currency_basis: Inherited nominal account dollar convention; no new escalation or price year claim
turbine.scope: Aggregate turbine conversion account including represented child equipment; child ratings do not add separate capital.
turbine.conditions: Point-condition assumptions owned by companion specification; no off-design qualification. Replacement specification with held amount is a hypothetical offered design, not a marginal price prediction.

heat_rejection.provenance: assumed entering model estimate, not vendor quotation
heat_rejection.currency_basis: Inherited nominal account dollar convention; no new escalation or price year claim
heat_rejection.scope: Aggregate heat-rejection package; original estimate used total thermal MW, not rejected duty. Pump ratings do not add separate capital.
heat_rejection.conditions: Point-condition assumptions owned by companion specification; no off-design qualification. Replacement specification with held amount is a hypothetical offered design, not a marginal price prediction.

cryoplant.currency_basis: Inherited nominal account dollar convention; no new escalation or price year claim
cryoplant.scope: Cryogenic refrigeration package only; excludes separately costed auxiliary-cooling allowance. Original estimate used electrical MW.
cryoplant.conditions: Point-condition assumptions owned by companion specification; no off-design qualification. Replacement specification with held amount is a hypothetical offered design, not a marginal price prediction.

power_supplies.conditions: Point-condition assumptions owned by companion specification; no off-design qualification. Replacement specification with held amount is a hypothetical offered design, not a marginal price prediction.
